requirements.Title: HP’s First Business Ink Tank Printer
requirements.Description: Develop and launch HP's first business-focused ink tank printer designed for SMBs, providing cost-efficient color printing and high performance.
requirements.Rationale: Addresses a market gap in the CISS PLE Hi segment and reinforces HP's leadership in SMB printing solutions.
Dependencies: Strategic intent to protect SMB segment
requirements.Acceptance Criteria: Product launched and available for SMB segment with ink tank technology, validated as HP’s first business ink tank printer.

requirements.Title: AI Productivity and Manageability Solutions
requirements.Description: Integrate advanced AI features for print, scan, and workflow management to enhance productivity and device manageability for SMBs.
requirements.Rationale: SMBs require efficient solutions with minimal IT support; AI features differentiate HP from competitors and address customer pain points.
requirements.Acceptance Criteria: AI-powered print, scan, and workflow management features implemented and validated in product user testing.
requirements.citation: Magellan MRD, Page 4, Page 7, Page 10, Page 11

requirements.Title: SMB Device Management Portal
requirements.Description: Develop a consolidated portal for SMBs to manage multiple printers, targeting unmanaged and lightly managed SMB environments.
requirements.Rationale: SMBs often lack dedicated IT teams; a centralized portal simplifies device management and reduces operational overhead.
requirements.Acceptance Criteria: Portal available for SMBs, supports management of multiple printers, validated through usability testing.

requirements.Title: Lowest Business TCO (Total Cost of Ownership)
requirements.Description: Deliver HP’s lowest business TCO for SMB tank printers, including minimal intervention and optimized supply usage.
requirements.Rationale: Cost efficiency is a key buying factor for SMBs and differentiates HP from competitors.
requirements.Acceptance Criteria: Product demonstrates lowest TCO in independent benchmarking versus competitors; minimal intervention required as documented.

requirements.Title: Maintenance-Free or Reduced Maintenance Design
requirements.Description: Engineer the printer for maintenance-free or reduced maintenance operation, minimizing parts replacement over product lifetime.
requirements.Rationale: SMBs value reliability and minimal maintenance due to lack of IT resources; this reduces downtime and operational costs.
requirements.Acceptance Criteria: Maintenance cycles are reduced compared to competitors; validated through lab testing and customer pilots.

requirements.Title: Replaceable Maintenance Box
requirements.Description: Include a replaceable maintenance box as a new feature to simplify servicing and extend product life.
requirements.Rationale: Enables easier maintenance for SMBs with limited IT support; aligns with the goal of reduced intervention and maintenance.
requirements.Acceptance Criteria: Maintenance box is user-replaceable and documented; validated via service center and customer feedback.

requirements.Title: Keyed Bottles for Ink Refilling
requirements.Description: Implement keyed bottles for ink refilling to prevent errors and ensure compatibility.
requirements.Rationale: Reduces risk of incorrect refilling, supports sustainability, and improves user experience for SMBs.
requirements.Acceptance Criteria: Keyed bottles provided for all ink refills; error rate in refilling reduced in usability testing.

requirements.Title: Warranty and Serviceability
requirements.Description: Provide warranty coverage of 80,000 pages or 2 years (whichever is first), with customer replaceable parts and service center support (PHA and MINK thresholds).
requirements.Rationale: SMBs require reliable service options due to limited IT resources; warranty and serviceability are critical buying factors.
requirements.Acceptance Criteria: Warranty terms implemented; customer replaceable parts available; service center process validated.

requirements.Title: Sustainability – 60% RCP (Recycled Content Percentage)
requirements.Description: Design printer with at least 60% recycled content, exceeding competitor benchmarks (Epson 30%, Canon TBC).
requirements.Rationale: Sustainability is a differentiator and increasingly important for SMBs; supports HP’s environmental goals.
requirements.Acceptance Criteria: Printer contains at least 60% recycled content; validated through supplier and manufacturing audits.

requirements.Title: Mobile Printing via HP App
requirements.Description: Enable mobile printing capabilities through the HP App for SMB users.
requirements.Rationale: Mobile printing is a core use case for SMBs and supports flexible work environments.
requirements.Acceptance Criteria: Mobile printing feature available and validated in user acceptance testing.

requirements.Title: Support for PaaS (Printing as a Service)
requirements.Description: Ensure the printer supports Printing as a Service (PaaS) models, including SMB2.0 Solutions and Advanced View SMB portal.
requirements.Rationale: PaaS offers flexible, scalable printing solutions for SMBs and aligns with HP’s strategic goals.
requirements.Acceptance Criteria: Printer supports PaaS features and is validated in enterprise deployment scenarios.

requirements.Title: PDL SKU Performance and Compatibility
requirements.Description: Provide a PDL SKU with improved speed (25/20 min), PDL/PS support, and Blue Angel certification.
requirements.Rationale: Performance and compatibility are critical for SMBs with diverse printing needs; Blue Angel certification supports sustainability.
requirements.Acceptance Criteria: PDL SKU meets performance targets and passes Blue Angel certification.

requirements.Title: Telemetry Requirements
requirements.Description: Implement telemetry features for device monitoring, usage tracking, and predictive maintenance.
requirements.Rationale: Telemetry enables proactive support, analytics, and improved device management for SMBs.
requirements.Acceptance Criteria: Telemetry features implemented and validated in portal and device analytics.

requirements.Title: Perfect Print and Perfect Scan Solutions
requirements.Description: Deliver advanced print and scan quality solutions enabled by AI, targeting SMB needs for accuracy and efficiency.
requirements.Rationale: High-quality print and scan are top priorities for SMBs; AI solutions differentiate HP from competitors.
requirements.Acceptance Criteria: Perfect Print and Perfect Scan features implemented and validated in product testing.

requirements.Title: Consolidated Solutions/Services Offering
requirements.Description: Bundle solutions and services (including AI, device management, PaaS, mobile printing) to add value to hardware.
requirements.Rationale: Integrated solutions increase customer value and support HP’s strategic goals for SMB market leadership.
requirements.Acceptance Criteria: Solutions/services bundle available and validated in customer pilots and market launch.
